what: Paylocity sells payroll and HR software to mid-sized American companies, with a strong emphasis on employee-facing tools: scheduling, communication, surveys and learning alongside the payroll itself.
customers: Mid-sized American employers, on monthly fees per employee.
money: payroll, HR, time, benefits and talent modules
setup fees and interest on client payroll funds
moat: Payroll conversions are risky and rare, so retention is high, and the employee-facing modules make the software something staff use daily rather than only the HR department.
risks: Growth has slowed as mid-market hiring cooled
Interest on client funds is a meaningful profit source and falls with rates
opportunities: A 15.2% net margin and $491M of free cash flow on $1.8B of revenue
Revenue grew from $853M to $1.8B in four years
$272M of cash against $133M of debt, and analysts see about 13% upside
watch: Recurring revenue growth and the number of clients.
